decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. TXN-008056 posted on 2026-08-23 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-25. That is 63 days, within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 2511 cents. The approved contactless authorisation AUTH-008250 was for 2347 cents. No merchant receipt is attached: the 23.47 EUR the cardholder gives is a claim, not a receipt, and it matches the authorised amount. Lumen Bistro (MER-000056) is a RESTAURANT. The posting is 164 cents above the authorisation. The tip tolerance is 20% of the authorised amount, which is 469.4 cents. Because 164 is within that, amount-restaurant-tip treats the difference as an agreed tip, not a mismatch.

proposed_actions.reason: Your bill was authorised at 23.47 EUR and posted at 25.11 EUR. The extra 1.64 EUR is within the tip a restaurant may add, which is up to 20% of the authorised amount (4.69 EUR here). Under our policy that counts as an agreed tip, not a wrong amount.
